description: This file declares functions and structures related to name hashing and directory index management in a version control system or similar application, providing an interface for operations like finding, adding, removing, and managing entries in a name hash cache.

methods.name: index_dir_find
methods.description: Finds a directory index entry by name within the given index state; returns an int indicating success or failure.

methods.name: index_dir_exists
methods.description: Macro that checks for the existence of a directory index entry by invoking index_dir_find with a null canonical path.

methods.name: adjust_dirname_case
methods.description: Adjusts the case of a directory name according to index state rules.

methods.name: index_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry for a file with the given name exists within the index state.

methods.name: test_lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Tests or initializes the lazy-initialized name hash for the given index state.

methods.name: add_name_hash
methods.description: Adds a cache entry to the name hash in the index state.

methods.name: remove_name_hash
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from the name hash in the index state.

methods.name: free_name_hash
methods.description: Frees or clears the name hash associated with the index state.
